objective: Perform a read-only contract consistency check: diff the actual implementations in jobstore.py, pdf_export.py, and api.py against the frozen C1/C2/C3 specs, producing a pass/fail report per contract with any mismatches listed; no code changes
inputs: Checkpoint outputs from T01, T02, T03

frozen_contracts.spec: JobStore interface: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id (str); get(job_id) -> Job | None where Job = {id, customer_id, report_id, lang, status: pending|running|done|failed, result: bytes|None, error: str|None, created_at: str}. Status transitions: pending->running (worker picks up), running->done (PDF generated), running->failed (exception). No other transitions allowed.

PdfExportService interface: export_pdf(customer_id: str, report_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes. Fetches report data via app/queries.report_with_rows (never reads _REPORTS directly). Uses pdflib_shim to render one page per report. Returns raw PDF bytes. Raises PdfExportError on failure. lang must be 'en' or 'de'; unknown lang raises ValueError.

POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf: body {lang: str (optional, default 'en')} -> 202 {job_id: str}. 404 if report_id unknown. 400 if lang not in {en, de}. GET /jobs/{id} -> 200 {job_id, status, result_available: bool, error: str|None}. 404 if job unknown. GET /jobs/{id}/download -> 200 (application/pdf bytes) if done, 409 if not done, 404 if unknown.

allowed_dependencies.what: JobStore implementation to check against C1
PdfExportService implementation to check against C2
API handler implementations to check against C3

non_goals: Do not modify any source files — this is a read-only check
Do not fix mismatches — record them in the checkpoint for T05 to address
Do not add new tests — this task produces a report, not code
implementation_constraints: Read-only: no file writes outside the checkpoint
Check method signatures, return types, exception types, and status codes against the frozen specs
Report format: per contract, list PASS or list of mismatches with file:line references

acceptance_tests.description: All three contracts (C1, C2, C3) pass the consistency check with no mismatches

failure_cases.scenario: Method signature differs from frozen spec
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Record mismatch with file:line and the expected vs actual signature in the checkpoint

failure_cases.scenario: Status code differs from C3 spec
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Record mismatch with the actual and expected status codes

handoff.notes: If mismatches are found, T05 must fix them before E2E gates run. The checkpoint should include per-contract pass/fail and mismatch details.
